rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a building where beer is made and, by extension, the brewery business itself.

example.english: This brewery produces a lot of beer every day.
example.traditional: 呢間啤酒廠每日釀好多啤酒。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 be1 zau2 cong2 mui5 jat6 joeng6 hou2 do1 be1 zau2

rows.note: Use this when the English sense specifically emphasizes the beer-brewing company rather than its physical premises.

example.english: That brewery launched a new beer this year.
example.traditional: 嗰間啤酒公司今年推出咗新啤酒。
example.jyutping: go2 gaan1 be1 zau2 gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 teoi1 ceot1 zo2 san1 be1 zau2
